title: Local or advected: the upper-ocean warm anomaly of 2015-2016
query: Using the supplied GLORYS12 monthly temperature, salinity, velocity, sea surface height and mixed-layer thickness for 2011-2020 in the western Tasman Sea off south-eastern Australia (46-26 S, 147-162 E), determine whether the upper-ocean warm anomaly off south-eastern Australia in 2015-2016 was produced locally or carried in by the currents, through which pathways and at which depths. Surface heat fluxes and winds are not supplied.

region.name: Tasman Sea and East Australian Current
